label: People and groups (platform)
description: A list of user and group IDs that the platform maintains, such as the approvers of a request. People never edit it. Declared as an access field, everyone listed is related to the record and can open it with the field permissions of their own roles.
usage: Use it for the approvers field of a request entity with an approval binding.
Declare it as a read-only access field (canEdit false).
constraints: Read-only; written only by platform services.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Not focusable; read as a list of names.
